Definition
[Nonlinear (contraction) semigroup] 1. ch9:9.6.2-def-1\group Nonlinear Semigroups

  1. A family $\{ S(t)\} _{t \geq 0}$ of nonlinear operators mapping $H$ into $H$ is called a nonlinear semigroup if conditions (11)–(13) are satisfied.

  2. We say $\{ S(t)\} _{t \geq 0}$ is a contraction semigroup if in addition

    \[ \| S(t)u - S(t)\hat{u}\| \leq \| u - \hat{u}\| \quad (t \geq 0, u, \hat{u} \in H). \tag {14} \]
